prompt: Universities should accept equal numbers of male and female students in every subject. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Both male and female students are supposed to get equal access to every university regardless of their majors. While there could be some reasons for accepting the given view, I’m partially against it due to the fact that there are some subjects which are more suitable for a specific gender.

Some people hold the view that every university major is bound to have an equal male and female ratio. As there is equality in the university, everyone is highly likely to get an equal opportunity in the workplace. In this way, it can somehow deter gender discrimination and inequality in our society. To illustrate, in Myanmar, the marks required to apply to medical universities are different for male and female students , so that there would not be only male or female doctors dominating the medical industry, and it can also create a diverse working environment.

However, it is my belief that not every subject is equally interesting for both men and women. By limiting a fixed number of each gender who can enrol in every subject, it is not fair to some students who do not have a chance to choose the subjects they are passionate about and end up in different careers. For example, in Myanmar, some male students were rejected from marine engineering subjects, whereas female students chose it not because they are interested in it , but because it is one of the highest-ranked universities.

In conclusion, although there are those who point out gender equality in all university subjects, I believe that it does not need to be applied for every subject , and there should be some flexibility in some subjects aligned with students’ passions and personalities.
